caption:
You can't kill these 250 flowers, and they never need watering. 🌸

Every page is one bouquet drawn like an old botanical print, with big open blooms, buds and leaves in clean black outlines. Pencils work. So do markers and fine liners.

Some stems are simple enough for your first evening. Others have layer after layer of petals, the kind you'll save for a long weekend when you've been coloring for years and want something to sink into.

It's US Letter 8.5 x 11 in at 300 DPI. You get a print-ready PDF plus JPG and PNG files, and you can print your favorites as many times as you like.
